articles.title: Gas prices in the US are nearly half of Europe's: Why are American drivers paying so much less?
articles.titleEn: Gas prices in the US are nearly half of Europe's: Why are American drivers paying so much less?
articles.summary: American motorists are currently paying much less for fuel compared to drivers in the European Union. The average petrol price in the EU is almost double that of the US, highlighting significant market differences. Higher taxation in Europe contributes to this price discrepancy, making it important for consumers to understand. Diesel costs also reflect a noticeable difference, though the gap is smaller than for petrol.
